title: Verification Pulses and the Cost of Escaping Wrong Consensus
abstract: arXiv:2610.00256v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: External verification can correct individual outputs while leaving a self-reinforcing population in the basin of a wrong consensus. We study how the timing and addressing of a fixed verification budget affect recovery in an asynchronous binary register. For a general nonlinear response, we derive the minimum fuel required to cross a basin boundary under a peak verification constraint. For a finite population, an exact birth--death calculation gives the probability of subsequent wrong consensus after a pulse. Our main asymptotic result identifies the critical budget window: a leading term $N\log(x_0/b)$ and a correction of order $\sqrt N$, with separate variance contributions from repeated verification targets and autonomous amplification after verification stops. The distinction is substantial: with 16 majority-updated slots and 14 initially wrong, 9 random checks cross the mean-field budget threshold, whereas 23 are required for 95% eve

translated_title: 验证脉冲与逃离错误共识的代价
translated_abstract: 外部验证能够纠正个体的错误输出，却可能无法使自我强化的总体摆脱错误共识的吸引盆。我们研究在异步二进制寄存器中，固定验证预算的施加时机与寻址方式如何影响系统恢复。对于一般的非线性响应，我们在峰值验证约束下推导出跨越吸引盆边界所需的最小“燃料”。对于有限总体，通过精确的生灭过程计算得到了验证脉冲之后再次陷入错误共识的概率。我们的主要渐近结果识别出临界预算窗口：主导项为 $N\log(x_0/b)$，并带有 $\sqrt{N}$ 量级的修正，其中重复验证目标与验证停止后的自主放大分别贡献了不同的方差。这一区分意义重大：在16个多数更新槽位、其中14个初始错误的情况下，9次随机检查即可跨越平均场预算阈值，而要达到95%的最终正确率则需要23次。
tldr: 该研究结合最小燃料最优控制与精确生灭过程分析，确定了异步二进制系统逃离错误共识所需的验证脉冲临界预算窗口（主导项 $N\log(x_0/b)$、修正项 $O(\sqrt N)$），并证明仅跨越平均场阈值与达到高概率最终正确所需的验证次数差异显著。
en_tdlr: This work combines minimum-fuel optimal control with exact birth–death analysis to identify the critical verification budget window (leading term $N\log(x_0/b)$ with an $O(\sqrt N)$ correction) needed for an asynchronous binary register to escape a wrong consensus basin, showing that merely crossing the mean-field threshold requires substantially fewer checks than achieving high-probability eventual correctness.
